machine: Linux cloud VM, 2 CPUs, 7 GB RAM; client and server on the same machine (localhost)

scenarios.title: 256 MiB, server slows each connection to 4 MiB/s
scenarios.detail: What many CDNs and mirrors do; more connections, more speed.

scenarios.title: 1 GiB, no limits, local server
scenarios.detail: Raw speed on this machine; one connection over loopback is the fastest path.

scenarios.title: 128 MiB, server allows 4 connections at 2 MiB/s
scenarios.detail: A fifth connection gets HTTP 503. The most possible is 8 MiB/s.

scenarios.title: 256 MiB, unreliable server
scenarios.detail: Each 64 KiB has a 2% chance that the connection drops.
